provenance: The source project is a layout/motion clone of a real, live commercial site rebuilt under the FICTIONAL brand 'Northstar'. Every logo, mockup, avatar and badge in the source is an original invented SVG illustration (src/illustrations); none reproduce the real company's assets. This file is the closed `assetRole` vocabulary used by schema, allowlist and example.

generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Render the registered Northstar component for this slot unchanged. Never redraw, restyle or generate a variant.
generationPolicies.reuse-registry-or-placeholder: Reuse an existing invented registry entry, or render the neutral placeholder. Never generate a new mark, and never draw anything that resembles a real organisation's logo or name.
generationPolicies.placeholder-only: Render the neutral placeholder only. Never generate realistic marks of any kind.
generationPolicies.illustrated-person-only: Use an invented, clearly illustrated person (flat SVG). Never a photograph, never a real or identifiable person's likeness.
generationPolicies.invented-marks-only: Generate original generic app tiles (abstract glyphs, Northstar palette). Never real third-party app icons or logos.
generationPolicies.may-generate-new-original: Generate new original SVG/CSS artwork in the Northstar palette depicting invented Northstar UI or abstract shapes. Never trace or recreate screenshots, video frames or artwork of the original site or any real product.

globalProhibitions: Do not reproduce the original company's (superhuman.com) logos, wordmarks, product names, product screenshots, video frames, illustrations or marketing copy, in whole or paraphrased.
Do not use the original site's proprietary fonts; use only Hanken Grotesk, Source Serif 4 and JetBrains Mono (OFL) as declared in tokens/00-foundation/typography.json.
Do not include any real third-party company logo, wordmark or app icon (customers, integrations, partners, app stores, social networks).
Do not include real certification or compliance marks (SOC, ISO, GDPR, HIPAA seals or similar); use badge.compliance-placeholder.
Do not use photographs of real people or any identifiable real person's likeness; use person.avatar illustrations.
Do not load or reference assets from reference/ or .playwright-mcp/ (the user's saved copy of the original page and raw measurement dumps); they are excluded from this repo entirely.

brand.wordmark.description: Northstar wordmark and footer watermark (logo-header, logo-footer, wordmark-footer).
brand.wordmark.chromeOnly: Rendered by shell.header / shell.footer from global data; never a PageSpec media field.

brand.product-lockup.description: Product lockups registered in src/illustrations (lockup-inbox, lockup-pages, lockup-agent, lockup-assistant).

product.ui-illustration.description: Invented Northstar product UI drawn as original SVG/CSS (feature images, aside/bento art, grid images).

product.demo-animation.description: Looping illustrated product demo standing in for a video (hero/demo/feature-row slots).

editorial.illustration.description: Abstract editorial artwork for reports, resources and the enterprise hero.

decor.background-art.description: Abstract background washes, watermarks and CTA art.

icon.feature-tile.description: Original gradient/line icon tiles for feature grids and cards.

media.integration-strip.description: Rows of app tiles representing 'works with your tools'. Tiles must be invented generic marks.

logo.customer-wordmark.description: Customer proof wordmarks. Only the invented companies already in src/illustrations (logo-1..11, Brightway, Larkin, Halcyo, Kite ...) or a neutral grey placeholder.

badge.compliance-placeholder.description: Compliance badge cells: neutral circle emblem + 'Standard An' label only.

person.avatar.description: Testimonial avatars/portraits: invented illustrated people only.
